recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic ensemble portrait featuring four figures in stage attire, framed by a rough, torn-paper white border. The central figures are bathed in warm, golden stage spotlights against a dark, atmospheric background, with a heavy emphasis on rustic textures and a weathered, slab-serif title at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the clean white outer border and the dark, textured inner image
Hierarchy established by the large, distressed title over the smaller, clean subtitle
Visual balance between the formal evening wear of the central figures and the casual western attire of the flanking figures
Warm spotlighting creating a focal point on the central female figure's sequined dress
coreInvariants: Distressed, wood-block style slab serif typography
Desaturated, high-contrast color palette with sepia undertones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four figures arranged in a shallow V-formation, with the central two figures slightly larger and more forward in the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, dark, textured title at the top center acts as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold title, move down to the central illuminated figure, then scan outward to the supporting characters and the textured border.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space within the image frame; significant negative space provided by the thick white outer border.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and blacks providing shadows and depth.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white used for the outer border and highlights on the sequined dress.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm amber and golden yellow from the stage lights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark clothing and the bright spotlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and clean geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses thick, blocky serifs with a distressed, eroded texture
Subtitle uses wide-tracked, thin-stroke geometric capitals
Horizontal rule lines with decorative diamond centers frame the title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Internal grit and speckle texture applied to the main title glyphs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a heavy, textured slab serif with a light, clean, wide-tracked sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Horizontal divider lines with central diamond motif

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Rockwell Extra Bold with grunge overlay
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab structure and western feel.
Provides the clean, geometric contrast for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a cinematic photo of four people (two men, two women) in a mix of formal and western attire standing on a stage. Use warm amber spotlights from behind to create flares. Apply a high-contrast, desaturated sepia filter. Frame the entire image with a thick, white, torn-paper border that has rough, irregular edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, centered title at the top in a distressed, heavy slab-serif font in dark brown. Below it, add a subtitle in a light, golden-tan sans-serif font with very wide letter spacing. Place thin horizontal lines with a small diamond in the center above the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the border sufficiently rough and 'torn'?
Does the main title have a visible weathered texture?
Is the subtitle tracking wide enough to span the width of the title?
Are the stage flares warm and golden?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the torn edge effect
Amount of sepia/warmth in the color grade
Level of distress on the display typography
Number of figures in the ensemble
postGenerationChecks: Check that the white border does not have straight edges.
Ensure the slab serif font looks like it was printed on old wood.
Verify the subtitle is legible despite the wide tracking.
Confirm the lighting creates a clear focal point on the central figure.
recipe.reuseFormula: Ensemble portrait + stage lighting + torn paper frame + distressed slab serif header + wide-tracked sans-serif subheader.
